title: RWB-S6-E6002-APP: the qualification step has no operation, no bid table, no published names for the buyer read, the case move and the package, and no partner arrow in the connection matrix
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R5.6, R5.7, R7.3 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S6-E6002-APP; context pack S6 rwb-debtsale (service row, ownership rows, Architecture v5 slides 3, 4, 5, 8 and 13, Temporal and Drools slides 5, 12 and 13); legacy RWB-E6-002; FSD S6 Debt sale v3 A1.2, A2.6 and A2.6.3.1; TSD S6 Debt sale v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1 and T-A; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-14, R-DS-15, R-DS-16, R-DS-18 and R-DS-26; Business Requirements Program v4 5.13; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-DBS-06
description: (1) TSD S6 appendix T-A publishes five operations for the module (API-S6-001 to API-S6-005) and none is a qualification or KYC operation, while the legacy story names the award path and the data room read as its endpoints, which belong to RWB-S6-E6005-APP and RWB-S6-E5026-APP; the step therefore publishes no operation of its own. (2) R-DS-18 records the bid against the lot and the buyer, and the service owns bids, yet the two tables of the service in the context pack and in TSD S6 T3.1 (debt_sale_lot, debt_sale_account) carry no bid amount, bid time or bid reference, and LOV-LOT-STATUS has no bidding value, so the bid is written as a decision record and the missing table is raised. (3) The operation name of the rwb-partner buyer read, the name of the rwb-decision package activity and the name of the case-move operation are published in no source. (4) The connection matrix gives the S6 row no arrow to rwb-partner, while R-DS-14 to R-DS-16 test nda_signed_at, kyc_status, licence_expiry and panel_status of the bidder, so the row is declared as a one-hop contract read and the conflict is recorded. (5) The plan gives H only (RWB-S6-E6002-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON, RWB-PLT-N001-CON) with C, I and X empty, so the consumed partner row has no plan row. (6) The W-MAP wave of EP06 is 4 and the Arch v5 wave of rwb-debtsale is 3; the story keeps wave 4 and the release 30 April 2027 tentative. (7) The split plan carries no requirement id although REQ-S6-004 and REQ-S6-005 apply.
evidence: split plan slice RWB-S6-E6002-APP with three H rows and empty C, I, X and reqs; TSD S6 T-A.1 with API-S6-001 to API-S6-005 and T-A.2; TSD S6 T3.1 field lists DF-SAL-020 to DF-SAL-037 and T3.2 LOV lists; context pack ownership rows (two tables, five REST operations, event EV-23, workflow DebtSaleWorkflow) and connection-matrix row S6 (T to P7 and P5, T and E to P8, T to P2, no arrow to P3, P4 or S9); FSD S6 A2.6.3.1 and A2.6.4.4; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-14 to R-DS-18; legacy RWB-E6-002 Endpoints, Data and Permission checks
area: Contract surface, data model and dependency classes
proposed: Keep the plan's H, C, I and X rows as they stand; declare the rwb-partner row as class C with a placeholder name and a 2 s budget; declare the package as an activity on rwb-decision and the case move as the child stage outcome; record the bid as a decision record and raise the bid table for the DB story of this service; keep wave 4 and the tentative date; adopt REQ-S6-004 for traceability

title: RWB-S6-E6002-CON: the qualification, buyer and bid elements have no published schema, no bid home, no provided operation and no published names for the consumed rows
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S6-E6002-CON; context pack S6 rwb-debtsale; legacy RWB-E6-002; FSD S6 Debt sale v3 A2.6.2, A2.6.3.1 and A2.6.4.4; TSD S6 Debt sale v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.2, T5.3, T6.1 and T-A.1 and T-A.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-14 to R-DS-18
description: (1) TSD S6 T3.1 gives physical types but publishes no OpenAPI element, so the qualification, buyer and bid element names, their required flags and their formats are fixed by this baseline rather than copied. (2) The qualification element has no operation: it is a property of the answers of the data room read, the bid and the lot read, owned by three sibling stories, and this baseline must declare that without narrowing their documents. (3) No table holds a bid, so the Bid element declares an amount and a window with no home and the missing table is recorded. (4) The operation name of the rwb-partner buyer read and the name of the rwb-decision package activity are published nowhere, and the matrix gives rwb-debtsale no arrow to rwb-partner, so the call type of the buyer row is declared as a one-hop read. (5) No source publishes a REST case-move operation, so the case move is declared as the child stage outcome. (6) TSD S6 T-A.2 gives error statuses without a message id per condition, so each condition is bound to a message of the legacy and FSD set. (7) The plan's C, I and X rows of this slice are empty while the baseline declares a consumed partner row.
evidence: TSD S6 T-A.1 and T-A.2; TSD S6 T3.1, T3.2 and T4; FSD S6 A2.6.3.1 and A2.6.4.4; context pack connection-matrix row S6 and ownership rows; legacy RWB-E6-002 messages MSG-S6-001, MSG-GEN-001, MSG-P4-002 and MSG-P7-003; split plan slice RWB-S6-E6002-CON with empty H, C, I and X
area: Contract surface, interface names and data model
proposed: Publish the fragment with the placeholders, declare the three answer shapes and no provided operation, bind every error condition to one message id of section 14, declare the bid without a table and record the absence, and confirm the two names with their owners before the baseline is tagged
